The '''Endor tracking station''' was an abandoned research outpost converted by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to monitor ships throughout the system. The station first detected the arrival of a squadron of [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] shortly before their [[Second Battle of Endor|assault]] on the planet. During that assault, a group of [[Maccabree]] warriors attacked [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and her [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] aides at the tracking station before [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] arrived and forced them to retreat.
